scalars.scalar_value: Significant experience in California health care policy, government relations, or a similarly complex and highly regulated sector strongly preferred.

Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressively responsible experience in government relations, legislative affairs, public affairs, advocacy, public policy, political affairs, or related fields, including significant leadership experience.

items.item_text: Bachelors degree required.
Advanced degree preferred.

Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressively responsible experience in government relations, legislative affairs, public affairs, advocacy, public policy, political affairs, or related fields, including significant leadership experience.
Significant experience in California health care policy, government relations, or a similarly complex and highly regulated sector strongly preferred.
Significant experience working directly with the California Legislature, Governors Office, state agencies, statewide elected officials, and other California political and policy stakeholders.
Experience representing a large health care delivery system, health plan, integrated health system, employer, or other complex health care organization preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading teams and managing senior government relations professionals.

Experience operating within an integrated Public Affairs model in which government relations, communications, advocacy, community engagement, and other capabilities work together against shared organizational priorities preferred.
Proven experience advising senior executives on complex legislative, political, reputational, and business issues and translating external developments into clear strategic recommendations.
Experience working within a large, highly matrixed organization and successfully leading through influence across multiple functions, businesses, markets, and stakeholders.

Demonstrated experience managing lobbying firms, consultants, trade association strategies, coalition partnerships, and external resources. Exceptional political judgment, discretion, executive presence, communication skills, and ability to represent Kaiser Permanente credibly with senior external stakeholders.
Lead the development and execution of California State government relations strategies that advance Kaiser Permanentes mission, business priorities, and public policy objectives.
Serve as a senior advisor to enterprise and California market leaders on legislative, regulatory, political, and stakeholder issues affecting KP.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with elected officials, public agencies, industry partners, advocacy organizations, community leaders, and other external stakeholders.
Coordinate cross-functional policy and advocacy priorities with Public Affairs, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, Community Health, Labor Relations, Communications, and operational leaders.
Identify emerging policy risks and opportunities, develop clear recommendations, and support executive decision-making on priority issues.
Represent Kaiser Permanente in external forums and ensure messages, positions, and engagement strategies are consistent, credible, and aligned across the organization.
Demonstrated success developing and executing sophisticated legislative, political, coalition, and stakeholder engagement strategies in California.

Deep understanding of Californias legislative and political environment, including the legislative process, state budget process, executive branch, regulatory environment, and major institutions and stakeholders that shape public policy.

Strong relationships and demonstrated credibility with California policymakers, legislative leaders, administration officials, political stakeholders, trade associations, coalitions, and other influential organizations.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across political perspectives and build durable relationships with policymakers and stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to lead integrated public affairs strategies by working across government relations, communications, advocacy, community engagement, policy, and other disciplines without requiring direct reporting authority over those functions.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate emerging issues, assess political and legislative risk, and develop proactive strategies in a fast-moving and highly complex environment.
Ability to balance California-specific priorities and relationships with broader enterprise strategies, governance, and objectives.
